description: Controlled same-price contract replacement for an owned live Cap. Prepare an explicit old-to-new mapping bound to the current and pending candidate versions/digest, test that candidate, then activate only its verified snapshot. Does not recharge, purchase, or perform real delivery. Changed deliverables require buyer confirmation for new orders; old orders keep their snapshots.

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

name: migrate_cap_contract
